payload.fact: Cognizant says AI-assisted modernization saved 37% against budget, while a seven-person team delivered the work and a technical lead or architect reviewed every change before merge.
payload.expected: An autonomous coding-agent result would mean the agent replaced much of the normal delivery structure.
payload.actual: The agent operated inside a conventional accountable team with mandatory review.
payload.tension: The autonomous headline and the supervised delivery mechanism describe the same project very differently.
payload.target: The headline framing that lets the agent swallow the delivery team.
payload.reader_realization: The result may be real, but it was produced by an agent-plus-team system rather than an unsupervised coder.

angles.line: The autonomous AI-engineering headline resolves into a seven-person team and mandatory review of every change.
The coding agent could convert, test, and document the system, but every change still stopped at a technical reviewer.
The same deployment looks less autonomous when the seven-person team and per-change review enter the frame.
The agent gets the headline while the delivery team and reviewers remain inside the result.
Reported cost savings and ordinary engineering controls coexisted in the same project.

reasons.semantic_fit: The surface identity of autonomous AI engineering is unmasked as a supervised team delivery process.
reasons.role_mapping: The headline framing and the sourced seven-person-team-plus-review reality fill the surface and underlying roles.
reasons.surprise: The reveal keeps the reported result while changing who and what produced it.
reasons.instant_clarity: The mask-off relationship is obvious if the underlying label stays concrete.
reasons.operator_resonance: Leaders routinely need to distinguish product headlines from delivery mechanisms.
reasons.caption_economy: The fixed lines add length, but the two substantive labels can stay under six words.
reasons.cultural_familiarity: The Scooby-Doo unmasking structure is broadly familiar.
reasons.freshness: No other post in this batch uses an unmasking relationship.

reasons.semantic_fit: Broad coding capability is bounded by the concrete rule that every change needs review.
reasons.role_mapping: Conversion, tests, pipelines, and documentation form the capability; mandatory technical review is the constraint.
reasons.surprise: The autonomous label collides with a review gate on every change.
reasons.instant_clarity: The two roles can be read without knowing the project details.
reasons.operator_resonance: Mandatory review is a familiar and defensible engineering control.
reasons.caption_economy: Both the capability and review boundary fit in short lines.
reasons.cultural_familiarity: The template is legible but less famous than the current handshake image.
reasons.freshness: Two other stories support a Genie relationship, so batch selection would need to reserve it for the strongest one.

reasons.semantic_fit: The contract supports two readings of the same deployment rather than two products.
reasons.role_mapping: 'Autonomous modernization' and 'seven people, every change reviewed' describe one project from headline and delivery perspectives.
reasons.surprise: The second reading restores the human system hidden by the headline.
reasons.instant_clarity: The paired labels are direct, though the lower caption will require tight editing to meet five words.
reasons.operator_resonance: Decision-makers often revise vendor claims after seeing staffing and controls.
reasons.caption_economy: The five-word limit is restrictive but workable with 'Team plus mandatory review.'
reasons.cultural_familiarity: The image is known, but its corrected-reading convention is less universal than Scooby-Doo.
reasons.freshness: STG also supports a stronger two-reading use, reducing batch freshness here.

candidates.hard_fail_reason: The AI agent was part of the seven-person team, not a distinct peer group, and 'needs a technical lead' does not naturally describe the whole team as a shared trait.

reasons.semantic_fit: The source supports coexistence, but not two separate groups sharing a trait.
reasons.role_mapping: The agent sits inside the seven-person team and the center label does not apply to both sides in the same way.
reasons.surprise: The human-review reminder is useful but the forced symmetry weakens it.
reasons.instant_clarity: The familiar image reads fast even though its implied relationship is wrong.
reasons.operator_resonance: Readers understand that agents still need accountable review.
reasons.caption_economy: The existing three labels are short.
reasons.freshness: The batch does not otherwise use it, but uniqueness cannot repair the role mismatch.
